body:
Lands the nine still-applicable launch-sweep fixes from 2026-09-22/23 that sat on single-commit branches (most were closed in the 2026-09-23 triage only because their registry row numbers did not exist; the changes themselves were never landed). Cherry-picked with `-x` onto current master, conflicts resolved, then rustfmt'd to the restored edition-2024 format.

| commit | from | change |
|---|---|---|
| 334a250 | launch/123-nox-jet-shift-bound (#7) | ntt / poly_eval jets (CPU + Honeycrisp) reject an out-of-range n/k before shifting |
| 1fcb59e | launch/166-nox-fri-fold-shift-bound (#8) | fri_fold rejects k before `1 << k` |
| fed5f79 | launch/187-merkle-verify-depth-budget (#9) | merkle_verify rejects a path length mismatched to the charged depth |
| 2cad08e | launch/212-cover-hash (#12) | tests: hash_atom / hash_pair / digest round-trip |
| c68f1bc | launch/213-cover-reduction (#13) | tests: hash-consing, load-factor cap, compute_pair_bound |
| cf28cf5 | launch/218-particle-of-pair-canonical (#14) | decode rejects non-canonical Goldilocks limbs in a pair particle |
| 78da718 | launch/211-cover-cost-sync (#11) | tests: Cost arithmetic; `PATTERN_COSTS` locked to `reduce::COSTS` (COSTS made `pub(crate)`) |
| e2b0cfd | launch/198-nox-print-data-recursion (#10) | CLI print_data is iterative (deep results no longer overflow the stack) |
| 4f1b2eb | — | rustfmt of the carried files |

Not carried: launch/123-nox-probe (#6, lens pin 0.1 → 0.2 — obsolete, lens default ships brakedown 0.1.1 and master's pin matches); launch/40-decider-jet-trusts-hint (#20, master's specs/jets/decider.md already states the jet verifies nothing and cites #20).

## Gate (worktree with strata/hemera/lens at their origin default heads, RUSTFLAGS=-Dwarnings)

- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` — clean
- `cargo test --workspace --locked` — 208 lib + 3 cli passed (master baseline 161 lib)
- `cargo test -p cyber-nox --lib --release --locked` — 208 passed
- `cargo doc -p cyber-nox --no-deps --locked` — clean
- `cargo build -p cyber-nox --no-default-features --target thumbv7em-none-eabi --locked` — ok
- rustfmt --edition 2024 --check over rs/ and cli/ — clean

Note: release/0.4 bounds ntt/poly_eval through its own admission layer, but fri_fold's `1usize << k`, the merkle_verify path/depth check, the pair-limb canonical check and the iterative printer are not on release/0.4; a forward-port is a separate task.
title: fix: land the launch-sweep jet bounds, decode canonicality and coverage tests
